annotations.description: Windows WebKit omits links from Tab and Alt+Tab even in plain HTML. Link focus is initialized explicitly; Enter activation, Shift+Tab, menu keyboard operation and Escape focus restoration remain tested. Link tab order is covered by Chromium and Firefox, not certified for native Safari here.
